context.issue: PostgreSQL database authentication failure during test pool initialization

task.description: ADHOC: Diagnose and fix PostgreSQL database authentication failure. The test infrastructure can connect to PostgreSQL via psql and Docker services are healthy, but the Zig PostgreSQL client library (vendor/pg/pg.zig) fails to authenticate during connection pool initialization. Fix the connection string, credentials, or pool initialization logic to restore database connectivity for integration tests.
acceptance_criteria: Integration tests can successfully establish database connection
No authentication errors in test output
All integration tests run to completion (may have test failures, but connection succeeds)

result.summary: PostgreSQL authentication fixed: Environment variable BPM_DB_URL now properly set for test database connections. Zig pg client successfully authenticates to PostgreSQL 15 test instance. All migrations applied. Integration tests can connect to database.
